descriptionChirho: To determine or appoint beforehand, predestine, foreordain. A theological term used exclusively of God's sovereign predetermined purpose: in Rom 8:29-30 God predestined those he foreknew to be conformed to Christ's image and called/justified/glorified them; in Eph 1:5 he predestined believers to adoption as sons; in Eph 1:11 believers were predestined according to his purpose; in Acts 4:28 the rulers did what God's hand and plan had predestined to occur; in 1 Cor 2:7 God foreordained wisdom before the ages. Glosses: vorherbestimmen/prédestiner/predestinó/미리-정하다/قَبَعَ-مِنْ-رَأْسٍ.
